d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

The Paymaster is responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely processing of payroll while maintaining compliance with company policies and local regulations. This role plays a critical part in supporting payroll operations and delivering exceptional internal service to employees across the hotel.
q: Previous experience in a payroll, paymaster, finance, or accounting role.
Strong knowledge of Bayan and OnTrack systems is highly preferred.
Good understanding of payroll regulations and accounting principles.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
r: li
Process monthly payroll accurately and within established timelines.
li
Maintain employee payroll records, deductions, allowances, and benefits.
li
Ensure compliance with company policies, labor laws, and payroll procedures.
li
Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
li
Coordinate with Human Resources and Finance teams on payroll-related matters.
li
Handle employee payroll inquiries professionally and confidentially.
li
Support audits and ensure payroll documentation is maintained accurately.
li
Utilize payroll and HR systems to ensure data integrity and efficient processing.

d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. The business operates at the intersection of premium property, capital, and bespoke client service, with a strong emphasis on quality, discretion, and long-term value creation. This role sits within a high-touch environment where trusted relationships and exceptional client experience are central to success.

As a Senior Relationship Manager, you will represent AHS in building lasting relationships with clients and investors whose expectations are exceptionally high. The role is centered on understanding individual goals, guiding clients through significant property and investment decisions, and ensuring every interaction reflects a tailored, polished, and highly professional standard. You will work closely across teams to support complex transactions and strengthen long-term client loyalty.
q: Senior-level experience managing ultra-high-net-worth clients in luxury real estate.
Demonstrated success generating referrals, repeat business, and closing high-value sales in a client relationship or sales role.
Strong knowledge of Dubai’s luxury property and investment market.
Excellent negotiation skills and a proven ability to build long-term relationships with discerning clients.
Experience delivering discreet, personalized service across complex client transactions.
Availability for evening client meetings, weekend responsiveness, and being reachable outside usual office hours.
r: li
Build and maintain trusted relationships with ultra-high-net-worth clients and investors.
li
Serve as the primary contact throughout luxury property sales and investments.
li
Understand client objectives and recommend suitable luxury real estate opportunities.
li
Coordinate internal teams to ensure seamless, personalized client experiences.
li
Grow referrals and repeat business through proactive relationship management.
